limitations: Only prime cyclic orders p>=5 and positive real one-site impulse amplitudes. Zero ambiguity at exceptional amplitudes does not imply nonlinear phase-retrieval failure. Bounded historical-priority search and no independent validation.
scientific_integrity: The zero-set classification and resulting linear tomography ranks are established analytically using finite quadratic Gauss sums; finite checks are supplementary. Prior sufficient phase-retrieval and Gram-spectrum results are explicitly credited.
title: Arithmetic resonance in positive-impulse repairs of cubic cyclic Gabor chirps
